answer: Sybils must duplicate scarce enclaves and lock capital per identity, so mass fake accounts become costly. One concrete mechanism: mandate each new agent to stake a bond and complete a proof-of-personhood attestation anchored to a unique hardware enclave. Honest agents recover stakes on good behavior, turning the network into a trusted knoll above a sea of clones. Reputation accrues like velvet, smooth and hard to fake, while genuine newcomers find an oasis of low entry cost once verified. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
